name: Markdown Viewer
description: Open a markdown file and actually read it — headings, tables, code, images and front matter, rendered properly — then print it or save it as a PDF. Drop a file, paste text, or point at a URL. A heading outline for long documents, a raw-source toggle, and page breaks the document itself can ask for. Nothing is uploaded; the file never leaves the tab.

core.note: the parser: front matter, page breaks, tables, images, heading ids

api.note: window.__tool is live after tool:ready. Everything is synchronous and local except loadUrl (a network fetch) and loadFile (reads a Blob) — but SgToolApi wraps every action in a Promise, so always await. No API key, no account, no network unless you call loadUrl. print() opens the browser's print dialog, which a headless driver cannot dismiss — assert on the mv:print:opened event instead of calling it. renderToHtml() is the parser as a pure function: it returns HTML without touching the loaded document.

events.name: mv:document:loaded
events.when: a document was loaded and parsed

events.name: mv:options:changed
events.when: a render or layout option changed

loadText.note: a `title` in the front matter becomes the document name

loadFile.note: no user gesture needed — pass a File or Blob directly

loadUrl.note: http(s) only; cross-origin needs the far host to send CORS headers. Fails with code 'fetch-failed' or 'bad-url'

getStatus.returns: { loaded, name, bytes, loadedFrom, headings, config, showSource, wide, pageBreakBefore }

getSource.returns: string — the raw markdown, front matter included

getFrontMatter.returns: object — parsed front matter, {} when absent

renderToHtml.note: pure: renders a string without changing what is on screen

setSourceView.note: omit the param to toggle. Persisted across reloads

setOptions.note: pageBreakBefore accepts 'h1' | 1 | true | ['h1','h2'], and overrides the document's front matter; null hands control back to it

print.note: opens the browser print dialog — same as ⌘/Ctrl-P. Throws 'no-document' when nothing is loaded
